name: stash
description: Stash — save anything, organize it, come back to it. Open-source, self-hosted, BYO-AI-key save-for-later app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stash/shared && npm run build --workspace @stash/api && npm run build --workspace @stash/web
